name: Omahours
author: Erik Scholz
description: A multi-project timer that only takes five characters of your bar. Pauses on lock and suspend.

barWidget.description: Time of the last used project. Left click opens the list, right click starts or pauses.

schema.label: Data file
schema.description: JSON file with your projects. Empty uses ~/.local/share/omahours/projects.json. A synced folder works.

schema.label: Pause on lock/suspend
schema.description: Pause the running project while the screen is locked or the machine is suspended and continue it afterwards.

schema.label: Colored timer
schema.description: Green while running, dark red while paused. Off uses the bar icon color, dimmed while paused.
